q: How long does a typical custom software project take?
a: Project timelines depend on complexity. Fast-track web applications take 3 to 6 weeks, while enterprise software platforms and mobile ecosystems typically require 2 to 4 months. We provide detailed sprint milestones and transparent delivery dates before kickoff.

q: Do you provide post-launch support and SLAs?
a: Yes. All projects include an initial complimentary warranty period followed by customizable SLA maintenance plans that include server health monitoring, security patches, regular backups, and ongoing feature development.

q: Who retains the intellectual property (IP) and source code?
a: You retain 100% full intellectual property ownership of all custom source code, design assets, and database schemas developed for your project upon final payment settlement.
